verdict.rationale: Exa documents event-driven pieces in Websets: scheduled searches that surface new web events (exa-docs-10), and real-time HTTP webhook callbacks when items are added or enriched (exa-docs-21, exa-docs-53). Websets criteria act as matching rules for what becomes an item (exa-docs-28, exa-docs-52). However, there is no documented user-defined rule engine that maps events or conditions to configurable actions; downstream actions must be built by the webhook consumer. Missing for 10: a native event-to-action rule configuration, a documented catalog of trigger and action types, depth on scheduling/monitor configuration, and independent hands-on corroboration of the automation flow.
